stages.event: You stand before the Great Pyramid of Giza. The hot desert sun beats down upon you. You must navigate the ancient structure to progress.
You explore the dusty hallways of the pyramid, searching for a pathway forward. You notice two tunnels leading in opposite directions.

choices.2: Navigate the narrow tunnel with quick reflexes (INT).
choices.3: Lose yourself in thought and consider the alternatives (HAP)

stages.event: A fierce %%HOSTILE_PET%% charges towards you, baring its teeth. You may be able to intimidate it away.

choices.2: Display your agility in a daring dance (DEX).
choices.3: Use your intelligence to outwit the creature (INT)

stages.event: A sneaky %%HOSTILE_PET%% stalks you, intent on attack. You must quickly escape its grasp.

choices.1: Make a break for it, relying on your agility (DEX).
choices.2: Use your intelligence to analyze the situation and find a weakness (INT).
choices.3: Try to flee with calm, collected movements (HAP)

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You come across a mysterious chest in the depths of the pyramid. But is it truly a treasure trove?

choices.1: Smash it open with brute force (ATT), doubling loot on success if you choose this option.
choices.2: Carefully inspect the lock for traps or dangers (DEX).
choices.3: Kick it in with a hopeful spirit (HAP).

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You stumble upon a genuine treasure chest! But what wonders or dangers lie within?

choices.1: Burst it open with unbridled enthusiasm (ATT).
choices.2: Inspect the chest for any hidden mechanisms (DEX).
choices.3: Gamble and hope for the best (ENE), increasing the chance of a pleasant surprise if you choose this option.

stages.event: You have reached the exit of the pyramid, where treasures and knowledge await. You must make your way back to civilization.

choices.1: Lead the way, using your knowledge of the pyramid (INT).
choices.2: Quickly survey your surroundings for hidden dangers (DEX).
choices.3: Make your way back, relying on your instincts and intuition (HAP)
